name: dsh-step-slide-in
description: New elements fly in along the line from their parent group visual centre, over-scale before landing and settle with a spring; removed elements become fixed ghosts. Compositor-only and stateless: no inline styles, so content can never be left hidden. A density setting picks whether the element, its parent or its grandparent carries the animation. An optional Swarm Cursors mode instead sends a flock of cursors to draw a selection box around each new element before it appears; exits are unchanged.
author: Adreno
